permanent_archive_protocol.scope: Protocol for assembling and independently verifying the technical-release archive; this document does not assert an archive commit or a completed archive readback.
permanent_archive_protocol.assembly_record_rule: Parent generates these records after assembly and includes them in the final frozen payload.
permanent_archive_protocol.verification_rule: Use the existing assemble/freeze/remote-byte-verify workflow. Verify the sole parent, prefix-only additions, all frozen paths/modes and independently fetched remote blob bytes.
permanent_archive_protocol.external_results_location: Actual remote archive commit and byte-readback proof belong in a separate verification branch and the final issue #52 handoff.
permanent_archive_protocol.retention_rule: Retain actual browser-downloaded ZIP bytes; only verified Actions transport wrappers and exact fixed prior-terrain references may be omitted under assembly-scope.

handoff_protocol.scope: Post-verification handoff protocol; no final issue comment or archive URL is asserted here.
